items.title: Curtis Fuller — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Gary Bartz father have club. I played there a lot there in Baltimore... So I knew the musicians, you know?

ctx.x: no. No, but I knew quite a few musicians run here. But, between here and Baltimore, I knew a lot of players. Sully Blaire was around here then. She was from Baltimore. Gary Bartz father have club. I played there a lot there in Baltimore.
A lot of the culture used to come in there and stuff, you know? I was around there for a while, two or three years, you know? So I knew the musicians, you know?
